history.summary: A freehold 2BR in Balestier/Toa Payoh fringe (D12), 750m from the future-completed TE10 Mount Pleasant TEL station, listed at $2,026 psf — ~5% below the $2,137 URA median. Freehold city-fringe with a 39-txn series at 6.4%/yr; the modest discount and TEL proximity make a reasonable but not standout case.
history.rating_rationale: PSF $2,026 is ~5% under the $2,137 URA median — a small genuine discount on a freehold city-fringe asset, and the 1,055 sqft 2BR is a generous-but-usable size. The 6.4%/yr URA rate rests on 39 transactions (acceptable reliability). Location is the swing factor: D12 Balestier is an established central-fringe locale 750m from TE10 Mount Pleasant on the Thomson-East Coast Line, giving solid CBD/Orchard connectivity. But $2.14M for a fringe 2BR is at the upper end of the 2BR liquidity band, Balestier is a busy/dense pocket (some main-road noise depending on stack), and 6.4% is good-not-exceptional. Balanced — a Neutral with a slight positive tilt from freehold + below-median pricing.
red_flags: $2.14M is high for a 2BR — upper edge of the liquid band
Balestier density/main-road noise risk on lower or road-facing stacks
catalysts: TE10 Mount Pleasant TEL station 750m — central connectivity
Freehold city-fringe location near Novena medical hub and CBD
